item.title: US releases names of 4 service members killed in the Iran conflict
item.description: The fallen servicemembers were identified as Captain Cody Khork, Sgt. 1st Class Noah Tietjens, Sgt. 1st Class Nicole Armor, and Sgt. Declan Coady.

item.title: Multiple US embassies are telling Americans they cannot evacuate or help them get out of the Middle East
item.description: US embassies in Jerusalem and Qatar issued statements on Tuesday saying they could not help Americans leave the Middle East.

item.title: What US companies are telling their Middle East-based employees during the war in Iran
item.description: Global US companies from JPMorgan to FedEx have staff and key operations in the UAE and are sharing guidance during the Iran conflict.

item.title: The US is urging Americans to leave the Middle East immediately. What to know if you're there.
item.description: The notice urging Americans to depart comes as airspaces in a large swath of countries in the Middle East remain closed for most commercial flights.

item.title: Some contractors who worked on OpenAI projects say Handshake AI is withholding thousands of dollars in pay
item.description: Handshake AI cut off access to the projects and told some workers they'd violated their contract.

item.title: Texas couple stuck in Dubai after cruise was canceled says they can't get help from US: 'I want to know an exit plan'
item.description: A couple from Texas are stuck in Dubai after the attack on Iran and retaliatory strikes. They said they can't get help from the US.

item.title: Ukraine's military drone guru says the next phase of Russia's Shahed war will be all about new extreme speeds
item.description: Beskrestnov warned that interceptor drones may "turn out to be useless" in the next phase, calling for new research into countering faster Shaheds.

item.title: I was at a QuitGPT protest. The discontent extends far beyond OpenAI's Pentagon deal.
item.description: A small group of 40 to 50 protesters gathered in front of OpenAI's San Francisco headquarters with a list of concerns aside from its Pentagon deal.

item.title: Ray Dalio says AI is 'eating everything' — and it might 'eat itself'
item.description: Ray Dalio says AI is "eating everything," but warns the boom could backfire if companies struggle to turn massive spending into profits.

item.title: I've lived in the UAE for 17 years. I ran to the basement as missiles flew overhead — and I still feel safe.
item.description: Dubai-based journalist Rebecca Anne Proctor says talk of a possible military strike on Iran has lingered over dinners and gatherings since the start of the year.
